title: P2LRN Native Composite Activity Profile
description: Defines a thin declarative activity that composes child Activities already present in the P2LRN graph without duplicating their content or runtime code.
rules: The representation media type MUST be application/vnd.p2lrn.composite+json.
The enclosing Activity children array is the sole authority for child identity and order; the composite JSON MUST NOT duplicate the child list.
Composite learner state MUST be stored externally and MUST NOT be written back into the package.
A sequence MUST NOT silently skip a child that fails to render or complete.
A composite renderer MUST use the same installed Renderer Registry to deliver child activities rather than bundling child runtime engines into the package.
